digest_convention: Sort the 24 repository-relative POSIX paths lexicographically; hash the UTF-8 concatenation of each path, one NUL byte, the exact file bytes, and one NUL byte.

findings.reason: A forged known EOL token is accepted as an intact uniform Cargo projection when the token disagrees with the current uniform bytes. Reproduction: a CRLF generated Cargo source with its recorded eol:cargo:crlf replaced by eol:cargo:lf returns {owned:'intact', hashMatched:true, reason:'intact'} from evaluateAttributedEntry. Doctor therefore reports the integration ready despite forged provenance; the contract explicitly requires forged uniform EOL attribution to fail closed. Removal also normalizes the restored file to the forged target style, violating exact restoration. External whole-file normalization can remain supported by accepting a differing token only when the current source hash is not the recorded afterHash.
